inlines.v: COMPREHENSIVENESS, noun 1. The quality of being comprehensive, or of including much extent; as the comprehensiveness of a view. 2. The quality of including much in a few words or narrow compass. Compare the beauty and comprehensiveness of legends on ancient coins.
